reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Filling implementation gaps in the National HIV and AIDS response towards achievement of accelerated universal access in Sierra Leone - Sierra Leone (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Sierra Leone, HIV, National HIV/AIDS Secretariat (NAS)This program has the following goals: To prevent HIV/AIDS, provide treatment, care and support, as well as mitigate its socio-economic impact at both national and sub-national levels in Sierra Leone. The objectives of this program are: Improve access to and utilization of HIV testing services (HTS) nationwide.. Promote improved health seeking behaviour and adoption of safer sex practise through BCC messages.. Provide quality home-based care and improve the capacity of families and communities to provide care and support for PLHIVs.. Scale up HIV prevention, care and support, and treatment programs for all high risk groups nationwide.. Provide prophylactic treatment to HIV positive women and their new borns, and promote safe delivery and other maternal services.. Provide Comprehensive HIV Care including antiretroviral Therapy (ART ) to adults and children living with HIV.. Develop and implement a new partnership framework for multi-sectoral and multidisciplinary national response at all levels.. Strengthen and expand national capacity to design, implement, monitor and evaluate levels and trends of HIV infections among the general population and population sub groups and collect and analyse data and disseminate strategic information.
